NSCameraUsageDescription: Artosia shows a camera behind the words on the projector when you choose one in Design.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Artosia listens to the room to follow the tempo and suggest the song being sung, when you switch Listen on.
NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Artosia reaches a camera on your network when you give its address, and lets a phone on the same Wi-Fi move the slides.
